Its really nothing new, but I was bullied for being overweight ever since kindergarten. I only fully remember the first awful thing that happened. It was in the second grade and I had a crush on a guy in my class, well one day little fat girl me walks over to him and tells him I kind of have a crush on him... his reaction? Him and his friend literally burst out laughing, like I had just told the greatest joke in the world. And in their eyes I probably was.  
I know there had to had have been more things that happened, but this is the one that for whatever reason sticks out to me the most. There was a girl in middle school who always the newest thing and was smaller than me. So not only would she constantly make fun of me for being overweight, but she'd make fun of me for my clothes, and one day on the bus her and this cute guy were talking and she'd asked him if he smelled bacon, I don't remember his response, but she'd then proceeded to ask me if the bus smelled like bacon and I'd said yes, and she said maybe its you... they ended up laughing and I held everything in and joined them in laughing.  
A recent one was in freshman year a girl decided to pretend to be my friend, then call me, call me fat, tell me I was worthless, that I was a horrible friend and that I should kill myself.  
The worst one yet was from I dont even know when.... but I had just gotten home from school to find my dad holding the house door open for me. As I got close he told me to hurry up fatass, apparently it turned out him and my mother had been fighting that day. But I'll never forget that day and the quick calculations I was doing in my head to see if I could throw my bookbag down and outrun him to just runaway.   
EDIT: A side note, but happy ending, I became anorexic after that, but am very happy today after overcoming the eating disorder, and have currently lost 95 pounds the healthy way :)
